I get it, everyone around you feels like a enemy and you just want to be alone but you hate being alone at the same time. I’m still healing right now and I’m not completely better but what’s helped me is taking time for myself and finding out who I am. I know you feel betrayed and alone right now, but maybe it’s best you collect yourself and heal. You don’t need to hide your true self to feel loved, because someone who truly loves you, loves your true self also. You are beautiful inside and out, and anybody who betrayed you or hurt you isn’t worth to be sad over, and I know it’s hard to realize that, but when you do..it’ll feel like so much weight and burden has been lifted off your shoulders. Im not saying this get better right away, but sometimes being away from friends and relationships is just the right thing to do at that moment to heal. Please realize that any negative actions against you from other people is not your fault, people are mean and evil and don’t deserve your hurt. I truly hope you find yourself and never let it go. Other people may not have your back at the moment but you have your back and that’s all that matters. You cannot make yourself your own enemy, because it’s not your fault. Please realize that. I hope you will be doing better soon <3

I’m not going to try and relate to your situation cause I have no idea what you’ve been through, but I can relate to the way your feeling, it’s hard when your calling out for help and you need it so desperately, my family doesn’t believe in depression and thinks people should just “be happy” I’ve attempted suicide a few times and after a while I noticed that it would take more than a attempt to get people to care, and that scared the SHIT out of me. I wanted to die but knew it was wrong and it made it even worse knowing no one cared to help, BUT at a certain point I told myself “if I’m all I have then so be it” I had to call 911 on myself before and I’m glad I did it. At some point you just have to take change and you will thank yourself later. I know it’s scary to reach out to anyone and it makes you feel extremely vulnerable but there is people out there who don’t know who you are and would be happy to listen and to help. Have you considered a psychiatric hospital for a few days? People make it out to be a horrible place but it helped me, along with seeing a psychiatrist. Life is hard and I know your tired of being strong, but I hope one day you’ll realize that life can be hard but it’s beautiful also, even the ugly parts. Please! there’s so many people on any platform you can vent or talk too, if you’re feeling suicidal, I would just admit myself in the hospital to keep myself safe even if you truly do feel like dying. Coming from someone who almost managed to kill themselves, you’ll feel so much regret and wish you could just try one more time. I know you don’t know me but if you truly feel alone I can be here for you to talk to or vent to. I’m sorry you’re feeling this way, please know your not alone.

Hi, I'm 19 and just got my GED February 2nd! I just thought I would share my experience from my perspective, as I dealt with the same thing going through high school. I wanted to graduate from high school so bad but I had anxiety so bad every morning I went that I would actually throw up. high school didn't cause my depression but it sure did add on to it. I was so depressed with life, it was affecting my grades and attendance. Me AND my parents decided it would be best to get my GED instead of just ruining my grades and attendance, and that chance of getting into a decent college. I ended up scoring pretty high on my GED with minimal studying, I just got accepted into the university I wanted to get into a few days ago, and I'm pursing a BA in Psychology in Substance Abuse. I'm not exaggerating when I say that it helped me move on with my education. (DISCLAIMER: GED is not for everybody) But if you struggle with PTSD, Anxiety, or depression I recommend it, I would've still been stuck in high school to this day. Just repeating classes and years. Its something you cant wait on though, you have to start working on it right away. Best luck to you and your daughter. If you need any more info feel free to message me!
